profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance and says it created the AI governance category. Its platform is built for what the company calls Measurable Trust, helping enterprises discover AI, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. The company says it is now defining agent governance, with agents treated as first-class governed entities that are registered, risk-assessed, sanctioned, and governed.

The platform includes GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), which the company says is generally available and compresses weeks of governance work into hours. It offers pre-built policy packs for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards, and the site states it integrates with 300+ systems. Customer statements on the site include Mastercard, which says it uses Credo AI to manage AI risk and implement generative AI, and IBM, which describes collaboration on Compliance Accelerators. The product is cataloged as an AI governance and risk management platform with policy packs for the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF, a clean interface, and fast deployment.

No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded for Credo AI.
